fields.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
fields.note: The prohibition, the definition of algorithmic device, and the civil action by a tenant or the City Attorney are all supported. The damages, injunctive relief, $1,000 per violation penalty and monthly separate-violation points come from a secondary source (DX06) that is not in this document, so they cannot be verified here.

fields.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
fields.note: The ban, the civil action by a tenant or the City Attorney, and the Oct. 14, 2024 effective date are supported. The $1,000 per violation and unit-month figures are not in this document.

fields.quoted_span: adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024.
adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024.
fields.note: The law went into effect on Oct. 14, 2024. The document says nothing about repeal or sunset, so in_force is consistent.

fields.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
fields.note: The document states the scope as residential units in San Francisco and mentions no limits by building type, unit count or construction date, and no exemptions.

fields.quoted_span: adding Section 37.10C to the Rent Ordinance went into effect on October 14, 2024.
fields.note: Section 37.10C of the Rent Ordinance is supported. The 'S.F. Admin. Code' form and the subsection aliases are not stated in this document.
